$comment: Catalog the installer reads. Hand-maintained; `npx ... --check` asserts every referenced file exists. skills[] resolve under plugins/workflow-kit/skills/<name>/, agents[] under plugins/workflow-kit/agents/<name>.md.

workflows.name: security-audit
workflows.description: Audit a codebase for security vulnerabilities: scan committed code, review it in parallel lanes, drop false positives, and report each issue with remediation.

workflows.name: scaffold
workflows.description: Start a new project from scratch: pick a stack, then stub and document every file in the tree under a per-file line ceiling, and verify the result.

workflows.name: docs-create
workflows.description: Author a documentation site from a written brief, no codebase needed: plan the pages, write each one, then verify and assemble config. Targets Starlight, Docusaurus, MkDocs, VitePress, Fumadocs, mdBook, or Docsify via the framework arg.

workflows.name: docs-scrape
workflows.description: Save an external documentation website as a local markdown corpus: detect the platform, then clone, scrape, or fetch the pages, and assemble them.

workflows.name: eatahorse
workflows.description: Orchestrate the eatahorse two-phase workflow: plan (decompose -> seed -> plan-gate) then, opt-in, execute (Ralph loop + completion gate + write-back). Dispatches to eatahorse-plan and eatahorse-execute.

workflows.name: eatahorse-plan
workflows.description: Decompose a goal into a Kanban board and gate the plan for soundness. Runs decompose -> seed -> plan-gate. Does NOT execute any work.

workflows.name: eatahorse-execute
workflows.description: Work an existing Eatahorse Kanban board one task at a time via the Ralph loop, verifying each completion. Runs execute loop -> completion gate -> write-back.

workflows.name: docs-from-code
workflows.description: Generate a documentation site from an existing codebase: enumerate source, plan a page per module, write grounded reference pages, then assemble config. Targets Starlight, Docusaurus, MkDocs, and other supported frameworks via the framework arg.

workflows.name: docs-migrate
workflows.description: Move a documentation site from one framework to another: convert each page to the target framework, check for leftover old-framework syntax, and assemble the target config.
